newsitem.title: USA: Dominican politician released from New York hospital.
newsitem.headline: Dominican politician released from New York hospital.

text.p: Dominican Republic opposition leader Jose Francisco Pena Gomez was released from a New York City cancer hospital after minor surgery, a hospital spokeswoman said on Thursday.

Pena Gomez, 59, who has had surgery twice for stomach cancer, had a feeding tube inserted during the Dec. 31 operation at Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Centre. Dominican media reported that the operation was intended to clear an obstruction in his digestive tract.

"Mr Gomez was released from the hospital Wednesday, Jan. 8. He had a satisfactory recovery from a minor endoscopic procedure. Mr Gomez is in good condition and is not expected to have any follow-up treatment at the hospital," the spokeswoman said.

Pena Gomez, president of the social democratic Dominican Revolutionary Party, underwent surgery in New York Sept. 24 to remove a cancerous tumour from his stomach. He had a similar operation in 1994 in Cleveland, Ohio.
